title: VexStream Music
summary: Projection of the persistent V4 desktop shell with zero-blocker default-visible coverage plus source-authored Library, Discover, Playlists, and Deleted terrain expressions.

notes: Generated by vexstream-vexboard-exporter/1 from source-owned semantic modules and the lived shell.
Product JavaScript is excluded from the VexBoard static view.

Every source-stable relationship attribute in the bounded shell becomes addressable; repeated affordances may share one Lens relationship ref. Home/Library/Discover/Playlists/Deleted plus Library and Discover nested modes are projected as browser-local source-authored expressions; deeper runtime/data states remain bounded.

entry.symbol: ShellNavigation + Library view + DiscoverNavigation + PlaylistNavigation + Trash projection

templates.summary: One durable Playlist rendered in the overview; identity survives ordering and wording changes.
One current Playlist entry occurrence. Duplicate refs and reorder prevent a stronger durable entry claim without a source-owned entry ID.
templates.instanceFormation: playlistEntryPresentationRef({ playlistID: playlist.id, trackRef: entry.ref, occurrence: occurrenceWithinPlaylist })

templates.summary: One durable Trash record rendered in Deleted music; identity follows source-owned item.id rather than row position or wording.

held: Current runtime Playlist and Trash instances remain unobserved; their source-owned identity formation is projected as POPULATION + template relationships without enumerating live IDs.
Playlist entry identity is CURRENT_OCCURRENCE because the Product does not yet own a durable per-entry ID across arbitrary duplicate-ref reorder/rebuild.
Trash selection, purge confirmation and purge recovery are distinct nested presentations and remain held until separately admitted.
Other catalog rows/groups remain runtime data populations outside this bounded dynamic-identity slice.
